section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses two limitations of the study. The first limitation is the reliance on self-report for outcome variables, which may introduce systemic measurement errors. The second limitation is that the analysis focused solely on Chinese students from six universities, raising questions about the generalizability of the findings to college students in other countries.
section_summary.evidence_source: Limitations There are two limitations to this study that should be noted. First, our outcome variables were measured by self-report, which may cause systemic measurement errors. To diminish the risk of common method bias, future researchers should use a longitudinal design. A second limitation is that our analysis was focused on only one group of individuals, i.e., Chinese students from six universities. We argue that our results can be extended to college students in other countries or areas; however, whether or not this is so, remains to be tested in future research.
